Title: Lernbaustein zum FDM: Schluss mit dem Datenchaos - Wie Forschungsdatenmanagement für Ordnung sorgt
Description: This course was created as part of the FDM@Studium.nrw project. It provides learners with the basic knowledge and practical skills required for data and file naming, with a particular focus on the term 'metadata'. Learners will learn how to name and organise data and files in a structured way. These initial steps in data description lead to an understanding of the meaning and application of metadata. Participants will learn what metadata is, why it is important, and the different types of metadata.

Title: Lernbaustein zum FDM: Von der Idee zur Wissenschaft - Die Entstehung von Forschungsdaten
Description: This course was created as part of the FDM@Studium.nrw project. It provides an introduction to the basics and significance of research data in the scientific process. Based on a presentation of different types of data, the term ‘research data’ is explained and categorised. Using the concept of the knowledge pyramid, participants will learn how knowledge is created from research data, why the management of this data is an important aspect in relation to the preservation, traceability and reuse of research and what the acronym FAIR stands for.

Title: Lernbaustein zum FDM: Datenrecycling - Wie Forschungsdaten nachgenutzt werden können
Description: This course was created as part of the FDM@Studium.nrw project. Research is based on data that is analysed in order to answer a wide variety of questions. Sometimes you have to collect your own data, e.g. via measurements, surveys or observations. In many cases, however, data that has already been collected and published can be utilised: this enables follow-up research and prevents duplication of work! In this course, you will gain insights into how to find research data and what should be taken into account when re-utilising it. You will learn how licences can enable re-use and receive tips on how to cite research data appropriately.
Keywords: university * studies * reuse of data * persistent identifiers * Creative Commons * research data management * Moodle learning management system * practical application

Title: Lernbaustein zum FDM: FAIR Play - Warum Forschungsdaten Management brauchen
Description: This course was created as part of the FDM@Studium.nrw project. It is dedicated to two terms that are often used in connection with research data management (RDM): the FAIR principles and the CARE principles. Participants will learn why responsible handling of data is FAIR and what is behind the acronym. The importance of the principles for the findability and accessibility of data, why data should be read and processed by humans and machines alike and what it takes for research data to be reused will also be explained. It also explains why ethical considerations are important in relation to data collection and use, and in particular the CARE principles.
Keywords: university * studies * Data management * research data management * FAIR * CARE * Moodle learning management system * Learning module * practical application

Title: Grundwissen: Datenmanagement in Studium & wissenschaftlicher Praxis
Description: This  Moodle self-study course was created as part of the FDM@Studium.nrw project. It teaches the basics of data in the research process, principles of digital publication, subsequent use, data organisation and file formats in four learning units and eight modules. The focus is on practical application and learning by example in order to teach students basic skills in dealing with research data.

Title: Einführung in das Data Wrangling - Konzepte und Umsetzung in SPSS
Description: This course was created as part of the FDM@Studium.nrw project. It provides an overview of the data wrangling process.

Title: Skalenniveaus - Eine kleine Entscheidungshilfe
Description: This video was created as part of the FDM@Studium.nrw project. It explains the concept of scale levels in connection with data wrangling. It describes which scale or measurement levels can be assigned to different types of data. Depending on the scale level of the data, different calculation operations can be carried out.
Keywords: Research data management * Data wrangling * RDM * Scale levels * Analytical methods

Title: Reliabilität - Ein kleines (Küchen-)Beispiel
Description: This  video was created as part of the FDM@Studium.nrw project. It explains the significance that the stability of a measurement instrument can have for working with the data obtained from it. It describes how the so-called reliability of measurement instruments can be tested and calculated.
Keywords: Research data management * Data wrangling * RDM * Reliability * Accuracy of measurement

Title: Rechtliche Aspekte beim Forschungsdatenmanagement
Description: This  video was created as part of the FDM@Studium.nrw project. It explains that legal aspects may need to be taken into account when working with data. It is pointed out that data protection rules must be observed when using personal information and that the consent of participants must be obtained, e.g. for surveys. Particular reference is made to the importance of data licences and proper citation of research data.
Keywords: Research data management * RDM * Personal data * Data protection * Licences * Transparency

Authors: Fritsch, Katharina : {https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0184-7823} * Bock, Sina : {https://orcid.org/0000-0001-6754-8810} * Blümm, Mirjam : {https://orcid.org/0000-0003-3665-7031} * Fellinger, Emma * Gremberger, Sam
Title: Die FAIR-Prinzipien - Daten für eine bessere Forschung
Description: This  video was created as part of the FDM@Studium.nrw project. The acronym FAIR - Findable, Accessible, Interoperable, Reusable - is broken down. It explains what measures can be taken to make data FAIR: from enriching data with persistent identifiers and metadata to the use of standards in the description and storage of data and the issuing of unique licences. The advantages of FAIR data are also discussed.
Keywords: Research data management * RDM * FAIR principles * Transparency

Title: Effektive Datenorganisation - Ordnerstruktur und Dateibenennungen
Description: This  video was created as part of the FDM@Studium.nrw project. It explains how the chaos of widely scattered files on the computer can be countered with well thought-out organisation. Tips are given on how clearly recognisable folder structures can look and which rules for standardised file naming should be observed.
Keywords: Research data management * RDM * File naming * Folder structure * Standardisation

Title: Kollaboratives Arbeiten - Niemand ist so klug wie wir alle
Description: This  video was created as part of the FDM@Studium.nrw project. It explains the questions of how to work together effectively in science and which measures can help to ensure the smooth handling of data in a group. The basic principles underlying good data organisation and information management are outlined.
Keywords: Research data management * RDM * Collaborative working * Data exchange * Information management * Reuse

Title: Die Macht der Metadaten
Description: This  video was created as part of the FDM@Studium.nrw project. It shows the function of metadata as a description of the content, origin and context of data. The distinction between bibliographic, administrative, structural and technical metadata is explained and the most important content elements are listed. The benefits of metadata are also explained.
Keywords: Research data management * RDM * Metadata * Reuse

Title: Die Datendokumentation - Dein Wegweiser für effektives Datenmanagement
Description: This  video was created as part of the FDM@Studium.nrw project. The process of how research data can be carefully planned, organised, stored and made reusable is explained using a strategic roadmap. It explains step by step which measures should be considered and described in the various phases of working with data and what benefits good data documentation can have.
Keywords: Research data management * RDM * Data management plan * Data documentation

Authors: Fritsch, Katharina : {https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0184-7823} * Bock, Sina : {https://orcid.org/0000-0001-6754-8810} * Blümm, Mirjam : {https://orcid.org/0000-0003-3665-7031} * Fellinger, Emma * Gremberger, Sam
Title: Datenspeicherung - Sicher ist sicher
Description: This  video was created as part of the FDM@Studium.nrw project. It shows what problems a sudden loss of data can cause and how you can counter the risk of loss with structured storage. It explains important steps that should be taken into account during storage and what is behind the so-called 3-2-1 rule for backups.
Keywords: Research data management * RDM * Data storage * Data loss * 3-2-1 rule * Backup
